title: The Unexpected Detention
author: Gideon Sandoval
blurb: Zephyrine Blackwood, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
